models.model_name: ANN-based AMP prediction model (Torrent et al. 2011)
models.architecture_or_algorithm: Artificial neural network (50 hidden neurons) using 8 physicochemical features (isoelectric point, length, secondary structure propensities, in vitro/in vivo aggregation, hydrophobicity). SVM also tested but less accurate.
models.input_features: 8 physicochemical properties: pI, peptide length, α-helix propensity, β-sheet propensity, turn propensity, in vitro aggregation (TANGO), in vivo aggregation (AGGRESCAN), hydrophobicity (GRAVY)
models.dataset_source_or_link: CAMP database (http://www.camp.bicnirrh.res.in/) and Uniprot; no direct download link provided
models.candidate_reason: Early AMP prediction model (2011) widely cited; full-text available; classification accuracy 90%; can serve as historical baseline.
blocking_issues: No code or web server available
Uses old feature set (8 physicochemical descriptors)

models.model_name: Deep learning regression model for antimicrobial peptide design (Witten & Witten 2019)
models.architecture_or_algorithm: Convolutional neural network (CNN) performing combined classification and regression on peptide sequences to predict MIC against E. coli.
models.dataset_source_or_link: Giant Repository of AMP Activities (GRAMPA); not directly linked but likely included in the GitHub repository
models.candidate_reason: Provides code and dataset; CNN model for AMP activity prediction; outperformed state-of-the-art at classification; includes regression capability.
blocking_issues: Full text not available to confirm details

models.architecture_or_algorithm: Statistical feature-ranking model (z-scores) with multiple ML algorithms (RF, SVM, Naive Bayes, XGBoost, AdaBoost, CatBoost, GradientBoost, ensembles) using q-value selected feature subsets.
models.input_features: Sequence-derived features; feature groups are ranked by q-values from z-scores
models.candidate_reason: Novel feature-ranking framework; high AUCs (0.9737, 0.8846, 0.97); code and datasets publicly available.
blocking_issues: Year listed as 2026 (potential future publication or error)
Full text unavailable for detailed method verification
